tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Everything sits on canvas; there is no tinted page color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Filled controls and groups on canvas: idle chips, secondary buttons, grouped lists, the segmented control track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on canvas and surface; the fill of primary buttons, active chips and dark badges.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, active chip, dark badge).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on canvas: captions, counts, store names, placeholders. 5.1:1 on canvas light, 7.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: tab bar top border, list row separators, outlined chips. Decorative only; never the sole cue for a control.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Placeholder behind product photos while they load or when there is no photo.

tokens.name: on-image
tokens.usage: Pills that sit on product photos (price, light badges, floating icon buttons). Same in both themes, because photos don't change with the theme.

tokens.name: on-image-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on on-image pills. 21:1.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: The unread dot only (8–9px). Never text, never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The theme color, set by the person (pink, blue or orange; see accents.ts). Fills the current sidebar item and the home hero's halftone. Never body text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. Ink reads on canvas, surface and photos' white pills.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The home headline only. One per screen.

styles.name: price-hero
styles.usage: The one big price on a product page.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Tab screen titles: Alerts, Saved, Owned.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section headings and the results count.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles (alert cards, product names in lists).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Search field, list rows, body copy.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Chips, secondary buttons, the verdict line.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Captions under tiles, store names, helper text. Usually muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges. Counts in uppercase get 0.02em tracking.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price pills on photos and prices in rows.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase headers above grouped lists, in muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Segmented control track padding, icon-to-text in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between grid tiles; pill offset from a photo edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding inside cards; gap under the search field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; list row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gutter beside titles; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a screen title and its first block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Price pills, thumbnails in rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The selected segment inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product photos in the grid.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Search field, alert cards, grouped lists, primary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, icon buttons, avatar.

tokens.name: elevation-field
tokens.usage: The search field and alert cards: the only lifted things on canvas. Dark theme swaps the shadow for a hairline.

tokens.name: elevation-float
tokens.usage: Icon buttons floating over photos.

tokens.name: elevation-segment
tokens.usage: The selected segment in a segmented control.
